page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1ne.8xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz. It features 32 dedicated physical cores with a single thread per core, providing 32 vCPUs. The system is equipped with 128.0 GB of RAM, yielding a memory allocation of 4.0 GB per core.

A defining characteristic of this instance is its massive local storage capacity, consisting of 94,489 GB of local HDD storage. This high-density storage configuration is paired with a baseline network bandwidth of 20 Gbps. The instance operates on a KVM hypervisor and does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses or GPU accelerators.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.d1ne.8xlarge offers high storage density per resource unit, making it a qualitative fit for scenarios requiring massive local data capacity without the premium cost of solid-state drives. Given the large HDD capacity and balanced CPU-to-RAM ratio, this instance is suited for storage-intensive workloads, large-scale data archiving, distributed file systems, and database deployments that require substantial local storage volumes.
